lead.t: Two key diagnoses are oppositional defiant disorder (ODD) and conduct disorder (CD).
lead.s: Neurodevelopmental Disorders II: ADHD and Disruptive Behaviour

b: CD involves a repetitive and persistent pattern of behaviour in which the basic rights of others or major age-appropriate rules are violated.
Aggression toward people or animals: bullying, initiating fights, cruelty, using a weapon or forcing sexual activity.
Destruction of property: deliberate fire-setting or other intentional serious destruction.
Deceitfulness or theft: breaking into property, repeated lying to obtain goods or avoid obligations, stealing items of value.
sec.s: Neurodevelopmental Disorders II: ADHD and Disruptive Behaviour

snip.t: Two key diagnoses are oppositional defiant disorder (ODD) and conduct disorder (CD).
snip.s: Neurodevelopmental Disorders II: ADHD and Disruptive Behaviour

snip.t: Disruptive, impulse-control and conduct: oppositional defiant, conduct disorder.
Key point: ODD does not by definition include the serious violation of other people's basic rights or major age-appropriate societal rules that characterises conduct disorder.
snip.s: Neurodevelopmental Disorders II: ADHD and Disruptive Behaviour
